name: d1440-heading
caption: Heading route, 1440 px. Production swings wide across the margin; Phase 1 drops to a square U-corner on the margin and returns under the heading; the final route leaves the plate on a 45 degree chamfer, runs down the margin and enters the left node on a second chamfer. No hook, no square corner.

name: d1280-heading
caption: Same region at 1280 px: the route keeps the same geometry as at 1440 (same ports, same two chamfers, no hooks).

name: d1024-top
caption: 1024 px: same geometry again; radius is 24 px here (page margin scale).

name: m390-top
caption: 390 px, from the hero to the first plates. Final keeps Phase 1 ports (the spine proposal was not better) and routes them with the distance-field router.

name: m360-top
caption: 360 px. Two short near-ink stretches (40 px in total) are the only remaining tight spots.
